subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should `session.scope: "global"` still preserve the configured heartbeat agent's workspace/session ownership for secondary agents, or should this config combination be treated as intentionally shared/default-session behavior?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally collapse global-scope sessions to `global`, but the multi-agent heartbeat expectation is agent-owned workspace/state; choosing the invariant affects routing, session-store ownership, docs, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve agent ownership
options.body: Fix global-scope heartbeat routing so the global queue can still carry the configured agent ID, workspace, and isolated heartbeat state for secondary agents.

options.title: Document unsupported combination
options.body: Keep the shared global-session behavior and add docs/doctor guidance that secondary-agent independent heartbeat work requires per-sender session scope.

options.title: Defer for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer reproduces the current-main global-scope path in WSL2 or Docker and records exact expected behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve agent ownership
recommendation.body: Fix global-scope heartbeat routing so the global queue can still carry the configured agent ID, workspace, and isolated heartbeat state for secondary agents.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and authored the closest shipped cron/heartbeat agent-routing fix and have the strongest current history signal in this path.
